quality.rationale: Schedule templates, Motion/OBS preview, expanded hosted font options, and vertical text display-bound resizing are implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes exactly 28 bundled default templates, Schedule filtering with eight yearly/monthly/weekly/daily templates, Sunday-start weekly template order, template metadata, Motion animation metadata, OBS preview window rendering, always-visible guided start, preview-pane edit state, Colors-to-Brand-kit registration, service-section removal, expanded Google Fonts dropdown choices, vertical text Adjust width/height editing, vertical text preview-handle resizing without unexpected movement, brand kit helpers, quality warning helpers, edit-state JSON recovery helpers, CSV/HTML persistence, inspector editing, WebP export, mobile no-overflow, user-facing docs, and QCDS evidence. Cross-browser, real-device, and real OBS setup edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, browser-local edit state, template, color, saved palette, and custom font storage, and client-side YouTube thumbnail import.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, README, user guide, and screenshot guide are present, QCDS evidence is recorded, tests/build/runtime gate pass, and docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow. A fresh remote Pages run after this commit remains pending until pushed.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested weekly Schedule templates, Motion/OBS preview, expanded font selection, and vertical text display-bound resizing passed validation: 28 practical bundled templates including eight Schedule starts, Sunday-start Weekly Schedule Landscape and Weekly Schedule Portrait, always-visible guided start, preview-pane edit state, Colors-to-Brand-kit registration, Templates service-section removal, 26 text-layer font dropdown options, and vertical text width/height edits from both Adjust and preview handles. CSV/HTML import/export persistence works, Motion fade assignment works, OBS preview window rendering works, WebP export works, and QCDS evidence is updated. Remaining satisfaction risk is broader real-user font files, real-device checks, non-Chromium browser coverage, and real OBS capture behavior.
